user.title: Fan remote and codes
user.description: Pick your remote and paste its command codes. The Bedroom Fan settings are filled in for new setups; existing fans show their saved settings. Saving does not send commands.

data.name: Fan name
data.wrap_increase: Increasing wraps from maximum to minimum
data.wrap_decrease: Decreasing wraps from minimum to maximum

data_description.remote_entity_id: The Broadlink or other remote that sends the commands.
data_description.power_on_command: Paste the full b64: code or a learned command name.
data_description.power_off_command: For a power toggle, use the same code as Power on.
data_description.increase_command: One press must increase the fan by one speed step.
data_description.decrease_command: One press must decrease the fan by one speed step.
data_description.oscillate_command: Leave blank to disable oscillation control. Toggle codes require the tracked state to match the physical fan.
data_description.sync_percentage_template: Return the actual percentage, 0–100 (0 means off). The Synchronize from template button reads it without sending IR. It never runs automatically.

timing.name: Timing and speed behavior
timing.description: Keep the defaults unless your fan needs different timing or wraps around at the end of its speed range.

data.wrap_increase: Increasing wraps from maximum to minimum
data.wrap_decrease: Decreasing wraps from minimum to maximum

data_description.power_on_percentage: The physical speed immediately after switching on. IR cannot detect it.
data_description.startup_delay: Seconds to wait after switching on before changing speed.
